note: Cerro Gordo County Conservation campground on 23 acres along a branch of Beaver Dam Creek in Thornton, just off I-35. Disc golf on site; the town's public golf course and Prairie Land Trail adjacent. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 22 sites, $20, reservable, showers/flush/dump; added 50A electric-only, back-in pads 43-58 ft, season, FCFS never (cashless, must book online). Not waterfront holds.
flags: Not waterfront holds, with a weak lead for AWH: on imagery the west row's pads back toward the small branch of Beaver Dam Creek, roughly 25-40 m away across a band of grass, reeds and brush; the channel is well under 30 m. Site pages never mention the creek. The band isn't clearly open, so no upgrade proposed.

Phone missing: 641-423-5309 (Cerro Gordo Conservation, footer of cerrogordo.gov page). apply.py won't write it. Dump station alone is $11 + $4 transaction fee.
